label: OK
gloss: no flaw a careful editor would act on

label: UNCLEAR
gloss: a reader cannot tell which thing, whose, how many, or what a term means (Qualified writing rules 1, 2 and 4)

label: DOUBTFUL
gloss: claims more than it can back, or may be wrong (doc-craft: Hedge)

label: AWKWARD
gloss: the meaning is clear, but the phrasing is informal, wordy, archaic or ungrammatical

label: EXTRANEOUS
gloss: a reader would act the same without it: repetition, history or authoring commentary (doc-craft: Earn each sentence)
